next.reason: 1985 defines selection objects as the operands or TRUE, FALSE and ANY in a WHEN phrase, collectively 'for all those specified in a single WHEN phrase, ... the set of selection objects'. §2023:14.9.13.2 carries the definition in the format, 'WHEN selection-object [ ALSO selection-object ] ...', with ANY, TRUE and FALSE among the alternatives. §2023:14.9.13.4 GR4 groups them per phrase: 'Each selection object within the set of selection objects for each WHEN phrase is paired with the selection subject'. The new alternatives (partial-expression, boolean-expression) are constructs 1985 lacks.
